title: Machine learning predicts mortality in septic patients using only routinely available ABG variables: a multi-centre evaluation.
summary: An LSTM using arterial blood gas measurements from the first 48 ICU hours predicted 96-hour mortality among septic ICU stays, with AUC 0.88 in multicenter eICU and 0.85 in single-center MIMIC-III, compared with logistic regression and SOFA. This supports a bounded retrospective prognostic result.
